message:
The weather report said a storm was coming, so you know what that means—family group chat time! I’m the one sending messages like, "Do we have enough snacks?" and "Who’s on flashlights duty?" It’s all very serious business when you’re talking about potential power outages and rain. 

I came across a handy resource that lays out some solid tips for preparing for storms. It’s great for keeping the family in the loop and ensuring we’re all on the same page. 

What’s your go-to tip for storm prep? Let’s share some wisdom!
